lastCompletedStory.title: File SUGGESTION follow-ups at the terminal verdict in runSidecarLoop

nextStoryContext: US-003 was the last remaining story in this PRD; all 3 stories (US-001, US-002, US-003) now have passes:true. Next `cam next` invocation should route to /cam-review, not a new implementer story. Summary of what US-003 wired: RunSidecarLoopOptions gained two optional deps, readReviewReportFn (() => ReviewReport | null) and fileSuggestionsFn ((report, provenance) => { filedIds: string[]; dupSkipped: number }), both consumed in a new hook in runSidecarLoop placed right after the CAM-191/ADR-0013 auto-ship block (i.e. after opts.clearActive()) and before the flipActiveFn auto-chain continue. The hook gates on result.status in ('complete','awaiting-operator') AND a re-read prd.review.lastVerdict in TERMINAL_VERDICTS (decide.ts), reads scripts/cam/review-report.json, and calls fileSuggestionsFn with provenance {source: prd.branchName, round: prd.review.roundsCompleted}. On >=1 filed id it pushes exactly one summary line via supervisorOpts.notifyOrchestrator (NOT a separately-wired notify closure -- reuses the existing RunSupervisorOptions field). PrdSnapshot (decide.ts) gained an optional branchName field for this purpose. Production wiring lives in sidecar.ts: exported makeProductionFileSuggestionsFn(cwd, spawnFn, logEvent) reads the open backlog via readBacklogFromMain, dedups via the US-002 dedupSuggestions/extractSuggestions helpers, and files survivors via createLocalIssueOnMain (default filing, no specSource -> stage 'idea'); a createLocalIssueOnMain ok:false result is skip-and-warned (failedCount tallied, never thrown) and a new 'suggestion-filed' WorkerEventKind/SuggestionFiledEventDetail (events.ts) records the outcome whenever there's something to report. buildSidecarLoopDeps wires this UNCONDITIONALLY (both operator and auto plan_approval mode -- unlike the flipActiveFn/autoShipFn pair, filing a non-blocking idea issue is not an autonomy escalation so it does not need the auto-mode gate). Idempotency has no prd.json marker: SUGGESTION fingerprint dedup (US-002) is the sole mechanism, proven end-to-end by a two-tick (awaiting-operator then complete) regression test in test/supervisor/suggestion-filing-hook.test.ts. Gotchas hit while writing the real-writer regression test (now captured in patterns.md): a canned/faked runSupervisorFn never invokes onProgress (onProgress is called from inside the REAL runSupervisor only), so that test omits runSupervisorFn and instead seeds a prd where decideNextAction resolves 'complete' immediately; and makeClearActive's implicit phase:idle rewrite always recreates the state file after the real onProgress unlink, so the correct post-run assertion is phase==='idle', not file-absence. File-size budget ceilings were raised for loop.ts/sidecar.ts/decide.ts/events.ts plus two new test-file entries (see scripts/file-size-budget.json _ref for exact deltas).
